description:
Perform a seasonal decomposition analysis on airline passenger traffic.

1. Import the raw data from `~/Documents/gretl_data/airline_passengers.csv`.
2. When importing, configure the data as **Time Series**, **Monthly** frequency, starting **1949:01**.
3. Create a log-transformed variable of the passengers column (e.g., `l_pass = log(passengers)`).
4. Create a Time Trend variable (Add > Time trend).
5. Create Seasonal Dummy variables (Add > Seasonal dummies).
6. Estimate an OLS regression model with the log-passengers as the dependent variable, and the Time Trend + Seasonal Dummies (excluding one to avoid the dummy trap) as independent variables.
7. Perform a joint F-test for the significance of the seasonal dummies (Tests > Omit variables or via the model window).
8. Save the full regression output and test results to `~/Documents/gretl_output/seasonal_analysis.txt`.
